name: The Gate at Dusk

effect: The chart costs more than the toll did.
options: Buy the chart|bad-end-lost#cost=coins:5#says=You buy the chart and it is a forgery.

name: The Harbour
effect: The road ends at the harbour.
context: The road ends at the harbour and the night is done.

name: The Forgery
effect: The chart was a forgery and the road is gone.
context: The chart was a forgery and the road it promised is gone.
